title: Compatible compactification towers with a supplied compactification of the composite
statement: Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{h}Z$ be separated finite-type morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with separatedness and finite type as in [def-weil-proper-morphism] and [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Suppose given compactifications $d=(i:Y\hookrightarrow\overline Y,q:\overline Y\to Z)$ of $h$ and $c=(a_0:X\hookrightarrow W,t:W\to Z)$ of $hf$, meaning quasi-compact open first maps [def-weil-open-immersion] and proper second maps [def-weil-proper-morphism]. There exists a compactification $e=(a:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,p:\overline X\to\overline Y)$ of $if$ and a proper map $v:\overline X\to W$ with $va=a_0$ and $tv=qp$. Put $U=\overline X\times_{\overline Y}Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with projections $b:U\to\overline X$ and $p_Y:U\to Y$. Then $b$ and the induced $c_X:X\to U$ are quasi-compact open immersions, $p_Y$ is proper, $bc_X=a$ and $p_Yc_X=f$. Thus $(c_X,p_Y)$ compactifies $f$, $(a,qp)$ compactifies $hf$, and $p b=i p_Y$ is cartesian. These data base-change to a tower of the same kind under any map $Z'\to Z$. Any two such towers for $f,h$ admit a common refining tower, with compatible proper maps on their ambient compactifications and on their intermediate schemes $U$, commuting with all tower arrows and restricting to the identity on $X,Y$. In particular, a refining tower indexed by $1$ mapping to a tower indexed by $2$ has proper maps $v$ on the ambient compactifications of $X$, $u$ on the ambient compactifications of $Y$, and $w:U_1\to U_2$, with $va_1=a_2$, $ui_1=i_2$, $wc_1=c_2$, $vb_1=b_2w$, $p_2v=up_1$, $p_{Y,2}w=p_{Y,1}$ and $q_2u=q_1$; here $c_1,c_2$ denote the open maps from $X$ to the intermediate schemes. No qcqs hypothesis is imposed on $Z$; existence of the displayed compactifications is part of the data.

proof.text: Set e = c.ofComp d. This existing construction closes the graph c.ofCompLift d in the fibre product of c.Z and d.Z over Z, using quasi-compact immersion cancellation and the immersion compactification construction. Set v to its closed image inclusion followed by the projection to c.Z. The properness instances and the toImage/image inclusion equation give IsProper v and e.i followed by v = c.i; the fibre-product projection identity gives v followed by c.g = e.g followed by d.g.

proof.text: Use e.restrict, with its literal fibre-product ambient scheme. The existing restrict_i_fst, restrict.comm and isPullback_restrict give the restriction equations and cartesian square. The compactification quasiCompact_openImmersion theorem gives quasi-compactness of d.i, e.i and e.restrict.i. Base change gives openness and quasi-compactness of the projection, and properness of the restriction map; proper composition gives IsProper (e.g followed by d.g).

proof.text: For k:Zprime to Z, define fprime between the literal base changes by the pullback lift of the projection followed by f and the projection to Zprime. Pullback cancellation proves its square cartesian. Separatedness, local finite type and quasi-compactness follow by base change. Let cf be T.cf.ofIsPullback of this square, cg = T.cg.baseChange k, and cfg = T.cfg.baseChange k transported along fprime followed by the base-changed h = the projection to Zprime. The ambient projections rU, rB and rA are the literal fibre-product projections. Pasting proves that rU also exhibits base change of T.cf.g followed by h. Define pprime and qprime by their two projections. Pullback cancellation makes qprime a base change of T.q, hence open; pasting and cancellation with the base-change square of T.cg.i give the cartesian square of the new triangle. Verify its open-map and proper-map equations by pullback hom_ext. Quasi-compactness of its open maps follows from quasiCompact_openImmersion, while quasi-compactness of qprime follows by two applications of base change to T.cg.i. Package v as a refinement of T.cfg over c, and use Refinement.baseChange for vprime; its i_hom and hom_g and pullback projection equation give all comparison equations. No scheme-theoretic-image base-change assertion is used.

proof.text: Set R = Triangle.inf (T 0) (T 1). This existing construction takes a common refinement of the compactifications of h and closes X in the product of the two pulled-back ambient schemes, then restricts over Y. Triangle.infFst and Triangle.infSnd give triangle morphisms to T 0 and T 1. For each index of Fin 2 select the respective morphism by equality case analysis; use its three Refinement.isProper instances and the fields i_hom, q_comm, p_comm and hom_g to obtain exactly the seven required equations.
